methods.label: Count three groups of edges
methods.explanation: An \(n\)-gonal prism has \(3n\) edges (\(n\) on each of the top and bottom bases, and \(n\) lateral edges). \(3n=21\), so \(n=7\). It is a heptagonal prism.
methods.levelReason: Counting prism edges and solving a one-step equation use elementary geometry and Grade 7 algebra.
